articles.summary: Court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia in landmark trial A Damascus court sentenced  Syria 's former president  Bashar al-Assad , his brother Maher and former security official Atef Najib to death on Tuesday on charges of murder, torture and incitement to murder. articles.title: Europe's Extreme Heat Wave Crisis Is Getting Worse
articles.summary: Another wave of intense heat is sweeping across an already parched Europe this week, raising wildfire risks, threatening crops and drying watersheds feeding the region's critically low rivers.
